title: secp256k1 stored-leaf birthday search at 124.677272370322345: truncated-fraction leaf keys, grouped hash-chain abort, free-boundary ladder

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, and its expected total work is at most 2^124.677272370322345 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 scalar AArch64 instructions per unit; certificate.py gives at most 246.1820 per leaf). Each pair of generator points X, Y gives six leaves, the x-coordinates of phi^t(X) +- Y for t = 0, 1, 2, from one batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2: with a = x_X, b = x_Y, E = b^4 + 2a^3 b, F = a^4 + 2ab^3, G = 3a^2 b^2 and w = 1/(y_Y +- y_X)^2 the leaves are (Ew - b) + beta^t (Fw - a) + beta^(2t) Gw, and only the six components Ew, Fw, Gw are computed, each as two 128-bit truncated fraction products (bwd 1285.5 instructions per pair, keys 140.5; 3.1-3.3). A class's label is the top 100 bits of v*/p and (beta v* mod p)/p, v* = min(x, beta x, beta^2 x); fractions add with stored corrections inside [-132, 194], [-132, 194] and [-389, 264], and a leaf in the window set W or the label-error set D' (rates below 2^-58.47 and 2^-16.65) is a charged missed collision (3.3). Records go in blocks of k = 256 over two hops (emit 7, h2s 7.25, delivery 4k + 2 per message (dlvk at k = 256: 1026)) and join order-free by hash chains over 2^57 heads (hchg 7 fixed, 6.5 per visit, section 4); every delivery is charged as executed route.s code. Success rests on Chen-Stein cross-node pair counting, the defect rows and the cap rates (section 6, success.md), with work E-averaged over a 114-rung early-abort ladder whose 113 interior boundaries are a stored table (LADDER_M, minimised directly on this ledger rather than on a power law, lowering the upper Riemann sum sum_g PHI[g] W_g) that stops at the first resolving rung under prefix non-stopping bounds. Worst-case work on every run is at most 2^188.698089 instructions (the least 6-decimal bound at or above log2 R_WORST, certified both ways), disclosed. Peak memory at most 2^135.9989 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^118.0361 units, included; no nonuniform advice and no added heuristic; certificate.py re-derives and checks every declared figure. This is an analytic bound, not a practical break, and no cryptanalytic novelty is claimed.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against exact arithmetic (every stored fraction against a bit-exact model of bwd and its error bound, the Fourier identity, records against a bit-exact model of keys, indices and labels outside W and D') and the class-rule and class-label tests; the emit, both hops (each message delivered by executing dlv or dlvk) and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py); the grouped next-array hash-chain early-abort run with stop, full and full-list cases on the true cumulative layout with read cursors (grouped_paths); the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
